title: Check Password Basic Rules
statement: Given a password string, return true if it contains at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, and one digit.
think: What is the task asking? Given a password string, return true if it contains at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, and one digit.
What is the key operation? Identify the repeated action over the input.
What wording signals stand out? password rules, scan chars, multiple flags.
What is the brute force idea? Use extra loops or repeated checks.
What is the better/optimal idea? Use a clean linear scan solution.
What are the edge cases? Empty-like input, single values, duplicates, and boundaries.
What is the complexity? For most of these easy tasks, aim for O(n) time unless sorting is required.
How would I explain it in an interview? State the pattern, the key operation, and the complexity.
algorithm: Return whether all flags are true
interview: I would solve it using Linear Scan. I would first identify the core operation, then apply a simple linear scan approach and mention the complexity.
